messages.content: Help me compute the updated coordinates for a set of vertices (10, 15) and (20, 25) after rotating them around a pivot point (12, 17) by 30 degrees?

function.name: rotateVertices
function.description: This function computes the updated coordinates of a set of vertices after rotating them around a pivot point by a given angle. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

vertices.description: An array of vertices to rotate, where each vertex is in the format [x, y]. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type float; they are not in string representation.

pivot.description: The pivot point around which the vertices are to be rotated, in the format [x, y]. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type float; they are not in string representation.

angle.description: The rotation angle in degrees. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the rotateVertices function with appropriate arguments. The function expects an object with keys: vertices: string, pivot: string, angle: string. The values should be strings representing arrays or numbers. For vertices: we have two points: [10,15] and [20,25], so vertices string should be "[[10,15],[20,25]]". Pivot string: "[12,17]". Angle string: "30". Then we call the function.

We need to produce a JSON object with the function name and arguments. According to the instruction: "When calling a tool, you must use the following JSON format: {name: <function_name>, arguments: <json_string>}". So we output:

{
"name": "rotateVertices",
"arguments": "{\"vertices\": \"[[10,15],[20,25]]\", \"pivot\": \"[12,17]\", \"angle\": \"30\"}"
}

But note that the arguments field itself is a JSON string. So we need to escape quotes inside. The outer JSON uses double quotes. Inside the arguments string, we need to escape double quotes. So the arguments string would be something like "{\"vertices\": \"[[10,15],[20,25]]\", \"pivot\": \"[12,17]\", \"angle\": \"30\"}". That seems correct.

Thus we output that JSON.
